customData.tooltip: Off — your word was 'noisy'. This toggle is why the macro calendar is *off* rather than *gone*, and why the dashboard tile reads 4/5.

customData.tooltip: One gate and one alarm. They are not the same kind of thing, and the screen currently draws them identically.

customData.author: agent
customData.tooltip: **A gate.** Below 0.70 a Signal never reaches the output. Lowering it does not reveal hidden signals in an existing report — it changes what the next cut contains.

customData.author: agent
customData.tooltip: **An alarm.** Nothing is dropped; crossing it tells you. Today's dashboard shows 2.4% — moving this by a tenth decides whether your morning has an alert in it.

customData.author: agent
customData.tooltip:
**Invented.** Nothing like this is on your screen as far as I know — I have drawn the guard rather than the hole, because you said this is the screen the second analyst breaks something with.

If a Brief has already gone to clients, changing 0.70 and re-running produces a second document with the same name. That is your parked versioning problem, reached from a different direction.
